There's a 50-mile water tunnel under London 💧
The London Ring Main, nicknamed "the M25 for water", is 30 metres deep and 2.5 metres wide. Thames Water says it was the UK's longest tunnel when it opened in November 1994, longer than the Channel Tunnel. It carries up to 1,300 million litres a day to about 3.5 million customers, moving round by gravity rather than costly pumps.
